series.name: EOP
series.color: light grey #D3D3D3 (the colour of the plot background)

notes: Panel 1 of 4 in reading order. 37 bars, one per model, in groups of 6, 7, 4, 13, 5 and 2 separated by an empty slot; every bar is a stack of the six legend classes (Correct at the bottom, Incorrect on top) that sums to 100 %.
Sample only: the bars at positions 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 and 36 from the left, the top of the Correct segment measured against the y axis. The other 31 bars and the other five classes are not recorded.

Worked on the bitmap embedded in the PDF page (677 x 1805 px, 220 ppi, JPEG (DCTDecode)); the bundle crop is that bitmap at 0.49 px per px. Panel box and plot area found there and mapped to the crop (map fitted on the bar blocks of both images, residual <= 0.8 px). Plot area in the crop: [19.5, 11.0, 327.8, 163.6].

y axis: tick labels 0 to 100 in steps of 20; the axis line runs on to 105. Calibrated on 5 ticks of the bitmap (0 at row 333, 20 at row 274, 40 at row 215, 80 at row 96, 100 at row 37): 2.96 px per 1 %, largest residual 0.10 %.

The shares printed in these bars cannot be read: the digits are 5 to 6 px high in the bitmap and 3, 5, 6, 8, 9 and 0 cannot be told apart on any enlargement tried (14x to 22x). The values are therefore measured (source raster, label_printed null): the top edge of the green Correct segment in the middle columns of the bar, to a fraction of a pixel from the colour mix of the edge row, read on the calibration above. Good to +-0.3: on the 24 bars of pictures 10 and 14 whose printed share can be read, the same measurement is within 0.19 of the print.

Measured twice. First on the bitmap (the values); then on a fresh render of the PDF page at scale 6 with its own calibration (6 points from the tick marks, largest residual 0.10 %) and another edge rule (plain green walked up from the base, the mixed rows over it added by their share of green). First / second: GPT-3.5 Web 33.33 / 33.31; Claude3-Haiku API 38.75 / 38.71; Mistralv2-7b-Q8 Local 26.63 / 26.54; Llama2-13b-Q5 Local 23.73 / 23.96; Llama3.1-70b Poe 41.25 / 41.38; Phi3-3b-Q16 Local 29.29 / 29.26. Largest difference 0.23; none over 0.5.

description: Supplementary Figure S7. Performance Stratified by Question Difficulty: 4 panels of stacked bars (4 rows x 1 column), 37 models per panel, six classes per bar (Correct, 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error, Incorrect) as percentages that sum to 100; the share of Correct is printed in the bar. Sample truth: the first and the last panel, six bars each. The printed shares cannot be read at the resolution of the embedded bitmap; the sample holds the Correct segments measured against the y axis.
uncertain: sample: 6 bars of 2 panels, the Correct segment measured against the y axis (its printed share is unreadable in the bitmap)

None of the 12 sampled shares printed in this figure could be read: their digits are 5 to 6 px high in the bitmap embedded in the PDF (677 x 1805 px, 220 ppi, JPEG (DCTDecode)) and half that in the bundle crop. On enlargements of 14x to 22x (Lanczos, bicubic or nearest-neighbour resampling) and as single pixels they stay blobs of a few dark pixels. By the coordinator's decision of 2026-11-19 the 12 values are the measured tops of the Correct segments instead (source raster, +-0.3), not readings of the labels. The 12 bars follow one by one. A printed share, where a method can read one, may differ from these values by up to 0.3.

Scorer hazard (docling/engines/figure_data/scoring.py: labels count as equal within a Levenshtein distance of 0.2 of the longer, values pair first-fit in prediction order). By that rule, computed here on lower-cased labels, these tick labels are the same: 'Llama2-13b-Q5 Local' (bar 22) and 'Llama2-7b-Q8 Local' (bar 19): 0.16; 'Llama3.1-70b Poe' (bar 29) and 'Llama2-70b Poe' (bar 23): 0.19; 'Llama3.1-70b Poe' (bar 29) and 'Llama3-70b Poe' (bar 27): 0.12; 'Llama3.1-70b Poe' (bar 29) and 'Llama3.1-8b Poe' (bar 28): 0.12; 'Llama3.1-70b Poe' (bar 29) and 'Llama3.1-405b Poe' (bar 30): 0.12; 'Phi3-3b-Q16 Local' (bar 36) and 'Phi3-14b-Q6 Local' (bar 37): 0.18. Against a prediction that lists all 37 bars from left to right the truth rows are then paired with an earlier bar instead of their own: bar 22 with bar 19 'Llama2-7b-Q8 Local'; bar 29 with bar 23 'Llama2-70b Poe'. Pair by exact tick label when scoring this sample.
